items.title: New photo album posted on Facebook
items.summary: A 9-photo album post was published on the company's Facebook page (same upload batch as the page's photos grid).

items.title: Ready apartments promoted at Banasree (1,560-1,695 sq ft)
items.summary: The company posted on Facebook: "Hyperion Condominium 100 % ready flat for sale @ 1560-1695sft at banasree. For details please call to Hyperion Design & Development Ltd. : 01701287501". A reel posted the same day had ~1K views; a companion 3:03 video posted June 13 had 394 views.
